title: Force Mandatory Fields in Zoho CRM Deals #Shorts
description:
Stop sales reps from skipping mandatory fields in Zoho CRM. Use native Blueprints to enforce required data on every closed deal stage. Set it up once and you are done.

1. Go to Setup › Automation › Blueprint
2. Define the sales process stages
3. Mark specific fields as 'Mandatory' for transition

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

#Shorts #ZohoCRM #Zoho #BusinessAutomation

angle.problem: Sales reps forget to fill mandatory fields before closing a deal.
steps: Mark specific fields as 'Mandatory' for transition
angle.result: 100% data completion on every closed deal.
angle.hook: Sales team skipping fields? Use a Blueprint to fix it.
